  • Constructor Details

    • StandardApplicability

      public StandardApplicability(String standardId, String edition, String applicability, String clauseReference, String evidenceReference, PhysicalInventorySafeguardingDesign.StandardEvidenceStatus evidenceStatus)
      Creates one caller-reviewed standards register row.
      Parameters:
      standardId - stable standard identifier, for example IEC 61511
      edition - adopted or candidate edition
      applicability - declared project applicability boundary
      clauseReference - inspected clause reference, or NOT_APPLIED
      evidenceReference - controlled evidence or public catalog reference
      evidenceStatus - evidence maturity
